claims: Independently reviewed the main REL-10-ICON-GATE contract and complete three-script diff from 31538ce; the clean result changes no product source, artwork, version/build, signing or package bytes.
Canonical scope check passed for the exact base and tool commit; shell syntax and git diff --check passed.

Canonical regression accepts the intended phone default/dark and Watch default catalogs, including reordered input, and rejects all 76 malformed fixtures covering missing, duplicate and unknown appearances, missing fields, invalid metadata/digests and unsupported components.

The filter validates every actual icon rendition and compares the exact sorted appearance multiset, preventing duplicate or missing appearances from passing. The MultiSized Image container is intentionally excluded from pixel-rendition selection while assetutil still validates the whole catalog.

The legacy default digest remains a single stable value independent of assetutil ordering. Each validated appearance is separately recorded with rendition name, digest, dimensions, opacity, color metadata, scale and idiom.

The corrected tool independently passed the real completed 0.2.0 (9) distribution IPA gate. This corroborates integration of the helper into the export checker; the IPA remains bound to binary source 31538ce in a separate REL-09-PREP signed-package receipt.
limitations: This source-only receipt approves the bounded verification-tool change. It does not relabel the existing IPA or full CI as produced from this tool commit.
No binary rebuild, signing, export, upload, simulator or physical-device operation was performed by this verifier.
